title: Barren plateaus in quantum neural network training landscapes
study_focus: Barren plateaus in randomly initialized parameterized quantum circuits under specified assumptions.
reported_finding: The work establishes conditions under which gradient variance is exponentially suppressed with system size.
limitations_for_comparison: A quantitative reproduction requires matching the paper's circuit ensemble, cost function, initialization, system sizes, and gradient definition. The current starter VQC is not that reproduction.

title: Cost function dependent barren plateaus in shallow parametrized quantum circuits
study_focus: How observable/cost-function locality affects barren plateaus for specified alternating layered ansatzes.
reported_finding: The paper proves contrasting gradient-scaling results for global and local cost functions under stated assumptions.
limitations_for_comparison: Do not compare the paper's asymptotic theoretical bounds directly with small two-qubit classification runs as if they were equivalent experiments.

title: A Lie algebraic theory of barren plateaus for deep parameterized quantum circuits
study_focus: Lie-algebraic characterization of gradient variance in sufficiently deep parameterized quantum circuits.
reported_finding: The work provides a general Lie-algebraic theory and considers certain noise models.
limitations_for_comparison: The theory's assumptions must be checked before mapping it onto the project's specific ansatz.

title: Investigating and mitigating barren plateaus in variational quantum circuits: a survey
study_focus: Survey of barren-plateau mechanisms and mitigation research in variational quantum circuits.
reported_finding: Reviews the research landscape and factors implicated in barren plateaus.
limitations_for_comparison: A review article; trace specific technical claims back to the cited primary studies.
